meta.title: GSL-250 — Interactive control plane · independent acceptance audit (run 01)

extras.Independence: Read ONLY shipped code + the design sources above. Prior stack-audit reports under docs/reports/web-stack-audit-2026-08-06/ were REFUSED per verifier-skeptic §6.
extras.Live environment: gosleep-core + gosleep-web booted from scratch on 127.0.0.1:{7331,5273}; killed at teardown, both ports clean.
extras.Live gates: core-smoke.sh — 66/66 PASS on hermetic endpoints. Confirms the routes that exist behave; orthogonal to the acceptance gaps below.

verdict.summary: The engine, the SSE fan-out, the Questions/Permissions loops and the Jira reconciler ship and pass 66/66 endpoint smoke — a real backbone. But the Phase-7 acceptance criteria the epic sells (SPA at :7331, Publish button + TouchID, Skills screen, runway KPI, populated Fleet cards, self-serve auth entry) are absent. Four CRITICAL findings sit on paths the PRD calls end-checks; without them, the owner cannot execute F7-S1 or F7-S3 as written. Recommend BLOCK on epic-close until at least the four CRITICAL findings are addressed or the PRD is re-scoped.

findings.title: SPA not served at http://127.0.0.1:7331 — PRD end-check unreachable
findings.design_ref: PRD Phase 7 §Goal + F7-S1 + Acceptance/end-check; target-arch rev 2 §1 row 7, §3.3.
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/src/serve.ts:41-46 (only API routes); apps/web/vite.config.ts (5273 only); apps/core/src/routes/ has no setup.ts and no static handler.
findings.description: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:7331/ → HTTP 404 text/plain body 'Not Found'. The React SPA lives ONLY on Vite dev 127.0.0.1:5273. Under launchd nothing runs Vite; a real owner following the runbook would see 404 and conclude the panel is broken.
findings.technique: code read + live curl against a fresh bun run --filter='@gosleep/core' start

screenshots.caption: Overview surface as it actually renders — only reachable via 127.0.0.1:5273

findings.title: POST /actions/skills/publish endpoint absent — first write button not shippable
findings.design_ref: PRD F7-S3; target-arch rev 2 §1 row 12, §6.2 table row 1, §9 step 7, §10 example.
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/src/routes/actions.ts registers 8 POST routes; publish is not among them. packages/schema/src/index.ts has no PublishSkillActionInput/Response.
findings.description: Live probe: curl -X POST /actions/skills/publish → HTTP 404. Combined with 'no Skills screen' and 'TouchID gate never invoked', the entire publish vertical is a hollow shell.

findings.title: No Skills screen in the web UI — only 6 of 7 promised screens shipped
findings.design_ref: PRD F7-S1 lists 7 screens including Skills.
findings.description: Sidebar shows 6 items (Overview/Fleet/Timeline/Questions/Tasks/Cost). /skills silently falls through the wildcard <Navigate to='/overview'/>.

screenshots.caption: Typing /skills into the URL bar silently lands on /overview

findings.title: TouchID .app bundle never invoked from core — physical-gesture barrier missing at runtime
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/bin/touchid-gate.app present + signed; apps/core/src/**/*.ts grep for touchid returns 1 hit — a comment 'TouchID is NOT required for these writes' in actions.ts:37.
findings.description: The .app is a dead artifact; no shipped POST calls it. Since there is also no high-blast write endpoint (finding 2), every shipped POST accepts Bearer-only auth — the security model the design promised is not what the code enforces.

findings.title: Overview missing runway / binding-constraint tile promised in F7-S1
findings.design_ref: PRD F7-S1 first bullet: 'Overview with runway = min()'.
findings.description: The first KPI the epic sells is absent; Overview degrades to row-counts. No RunwayResponse in schema, no useRunway in queries.ts.

findings.title: Fleet — model / context_pct / current_intent NULL for every live session
findings.design_ref: PRD R7.4 + F7-S1 'card per agent (context %, current tool, cycle, model)'; rev-3 addendum §8.1.
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/src/workers/fleet-poll.ts; packages/runner-adapter/src/claude-code.ts (contract: CLI does not carry these fields — PreToolUse shim was to backfill).
findings.description: Live /fleet: model=null, context_pct=null, current_intent=null on all interactive sessions. The Fleet screen renders name/cwd/status only.

screenshots.caption: Fleet — cards show status/cwd but no model/context %/intent

findings.title: No client-side auth-setup / Bearer-discovery flow — owner must hand-populate sessionStorage
findings.design_ref: target-arch rev 2 §3.3 (apps/core/src/routes/setup.ts); PRD Phase 7 §Acceptance criteria + end-check.
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/src/routes/ has no setup.ts; apps/web/src/data/auth.ts reads sessionStorage['gosleep.token']; main.tsx acknowledges 'Auth required' banner is the fail-loud stance.
findings.description: The owner needs devtools + `security find-generic-password | sed | base64 -d` to inject a token before the panel renders anything. On mobile Safari the panel is unreachable.
findings.technique: code read + browser navigation before/after sessionStorage.setItem

findings.title: /skills endpoint returns empty — skills registry has no writer
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/src/db/schema.ts (skills table exists, count=0); apps/core/scripts/ has no record-publish.ts.
findings.description: The whole skills vertical is present in schema + read-projection only; nothing writes, nothing reads (see findings 2 and 3).

findings.title: font-semibold (600) used across UI headings — violates design-system.md §5 500-weight cap
findings.design_ref: docs/reports/web-harness-research-2026-08-03/design-system.md §5 (last sentence — UI ceiling 500; 600/700 reserved for reports).
findings.shipped_ref: apps/web/src/theme/globals.css:96 h1..h6 { font-weight: 600 }; PageHeader.tsx:17; AppShell.tsx:49; Overview.tsx:25; Cost.tsx:95/108/121; Fleet.tsx:116.
findings.description: Live probe (Fleet dark, 1440x900): H1 'Fleet' computed font-weight 600; brand chip 'gosleep' 600. Contract-level design deviation across every screen.

findings.title: /version returns db_schema_version='unset' — placeholder never closed
findings.description: Client cannot detect a rolling schema change; the 'reload the tab on mismatch' story (§12 R34) is inoperable.

findings.title: Router wildcard silently redirects unknown routes to /overview — no explicit 404
findings.design_ref: Product hygiene; also PRD §Non-goals does not sanction silent redirect.
findings.description: Hides finding 3 (missing Skills screen) and any future missing surface.

architecture_notes.title: What DOES work (context for the owner)
architecture_notes.body: The Bun+Hono core boots cleanly (bind 127.0.0.1:7331, all security middleware including CSP/nosniff/XFO/Referrer-Policy, Origin+Host guards, Bearer, Keychain wrapper with 5s timeout+503 + Tahoe 26.x guard). SQLite+Drizzle schema + tail indexer + rotation + SSE broadcaster + persistent idempotency all live. Questions/Permissions loop through PreToolUse hook is present and lite-proved by GSL-267 (guarded) and GSL-284; core-smoke.sh 66/66 PASS. Jira reconciler + /metrics + defer-reopen + fleet-poll workers are all wired. The runner-adapter seam is honored (grep 'claude agents' in apps/core/src returns 0 hits). Rev-3 addendum Deltas 3 (transcript = enrichment only), 6 (Vite 7 pin), 7 (/metrics), 8.2-8.3 (manifest provenance + defer), 9 (Jira sync), 10 (SessionAdapter) are all met.
